note.notVrm: This file has no VRM data, so YDCP can’t show it.
note.tooBig: The file is {mb} MB, over YDCP’s 100 MB limit, so it won’t load.
note.missingBones: Missing body bones ({bones}), so built-in motions can’t pose her properly.
note.noExpressions: No expressions: her face won’t change.
note.allFaces: Has all the standard faces, so moments and pokes change her expression.
note.noStandardFaces: No standard faces, so moments and pokes won’t change her expression. Pick one from Motions → Expressions, or map them in a model profile.
note.someFaces: Standard faces found: {found}. Not in this model: {lacking}.
note.trackingOne: {n} face-tracking shape for VTuber apps (perfect sync). YDCP leaves them out of its menus.
note.tracking: {n} face-tracking shapes for VTuber apps (perfect sync). YDCP leaves them out of its menus.
note.outfitOne: {n} outfit part to show or hide, in the Outfit menu: {list}.
note.outfit: {n} outfit parts to show or hide, in the Outfit menu: {list}.
note.noBlink: No blink, so she won’t blink.
note.noPhysics: No hair or clothes physics, so her hair and skirt won’t move.
note.noFingers: No finger bones, so her fingers stay still and the Peace sign won’t show a V.
note.noEyes: No eye bones, so her hands are placed using an estimate of where her face is.
note.heavy: A heavy model ({details}), so she may load slowly and use more memory.
